title: Decision on Trademark No. 0874/MOIC, Dated 28 May 2025
text:
The Ministry of Industry and Commerce issued Decision on Trademark No. 0874/MOIC, Dated 28 May 2025 to establish principles and regulations governing trademarks, including registration, post-registration procedures, representation, and trademark management. The decision aims to ensure efficient and consistent implementation nationwide, support the country’s socio-economic development, and promote a modern, environmentally friendly, and sustainable industrial sector.
